scripts.db:create: psql -U postgres -h localhost -c "CREATE DATABASE ntms ENCODING 'UTF8' TEMPLATE template0"
scripts.db:ddl: psql -U postgres -h localhost -d ntms -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f db/run_all.sql
scripts.db:drop: psql -U postgres -h localhost -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS ntms"
scripts.db:reset: pnpm db:drop && pnpm db:create && pnpm db:ddl && pnpm db:pull
scripts.db:pull: pnpm --filter @ntms/db exec prisma db pull && pnpm --filter @ntms/db exec prisma generate
